faqs.question: How do I know this fits my MacBook?
faqs.answer: This fits the MacBook Pro 13" A1708 (Late 2016 or Mid 2017, Non-Touch Bar). Check the model number on the bottom of your MacBook, or send us a photo on WhatsApp to confirm.

faqs.question: Why is it sold as an assembly and not just a keyboard?
faqs.answer: This generation of MacBook keyboard is riveted directly into the top case, so it can't be swapped as a standalone part — it comes as a full assembly.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this?
faqs.answer: This keyboard assembly carries a 3-month warranty.
